prerequisites: Solving a second-order equation with constant coefficients with or without a second member
Analysis of mechanical systems consisting of spring assemblies in tension or torsion
Discrete finite element method in statics
Eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a matrix

learning_outcomes.text: Be able to understand free and forced vibrations of a 1-degree-of-freedom system and to conduct dynamic analyses of continuous or discrete mechanical systems.

syllabus_topics: Dynamic response of a 1-degree-of-freedom system in free and forced vibration regimes
Setting up and solving equations of motion
Introduction to vibration of continuous systems
Finite element method in dynamics for bar and beam type finite elements
Determination of mass matrices for these elements
Calculation of frequencies and vibration modes (modal analysis of a system)
degree: Licence Mécanique, parcours Génie mécanique et productique (2e et 3e année)
